34348-the-drama-of-glass.title: The Drama Of Glass
34348-the-drama-of-glass.creator: Miss Field.
34348-the-drama-of-glass.description: A book by Miss Field.. Great was the wonder of these Phoenicians--the Yankees of antiquity, the builders of Tyre and Sidon, the inventors of the alphabet--on beholding solid matter changed to a strange fluid, which voluntarily mingled with its nearest neighbor, the sand, and made a transparent material now called glass.

56903-introduction-to-the-scientific-stu.title: Education
56903-introduction-to-the-scientific-stu.creator: Unknown
56903-introduction-to-the-scientific-stu.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The American textbook method  of teaching. Independence of thought based on reading. European  schools caste schools, American schools truly public. Influence  of European schools on the educational system of this country. Report of the visiting committee of Taunton in 1801. Adoption of  the German model. Results of the adoption of the German example. The reorganization of American schools. Origin of the high school. Higher education free. American public schools  secular. The school system and its domination of the teacher. Exercises and readings.

61138-contact-and-other-stories.title: Contact And Other Stories
61138-contact-and-other-stories.creator: Frances Noyes Hart
61138-contact-and-other-stories.description: A book by Frances Noyes Hart. , and Janet had finished her coffee and turned the great chair so that she could watch the dancing fire (it was cool for May), her cloudy brown head tilted back against the rose-red cushion, shadowy eyes half closed, idle hands linked across her knees. She looked every one of her thirty years--and mortally tired--and careless of both facts. But she managed an encouraging smile at the sound of Rosemary’s shy, friendly voice at her elbow.

arxiv-2101-00447.title: Analytical Solution for Bosonic Fields in the FRW Multiply Warped Braneworld
arxiv-2101-00447.creator: A. S. Ribeiro, G. Alencar, R. R. Landim
arxiv-2101-00447.description: Abstract In this paper we find analytical solutions for the scalar and gauge fields in the Freedman-Robertson-Walker multiply warped braneworld scenario. With this we find the precise mass spectra for these fields. We compare these spectra with that previously found in the literature for the static case.

arxiv-2103-09428.title: Bulk properties of honeycomb lattices of superconducting microwave resonators
arxiv-2103-09428.creator: Alexis Morvan, Mathieu Féchant, Gianluca Aiello, Julien Gabelli, Jérôme Estève
arxiv-2103-09428.description: Abstract We have realized different honeycomb lattices for microwave photons in the 4 to 8 GHz 8\text{\,}\mathrm{GHz} band using superconducting spiral resonators. Each lattice comprises a few hundred sites. Two designs have been studied, one leading to two bands touching at the Dirac points and one where a gap opens at the Dirac points.

arxiv-2107-12297.title: H s H^{s} Bounds for the Derivative Nonlinear Schrödinger Equation Thanks: This material is based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. DMS-1928930 while the authors participated in a program hosted by the Mathematical Sciences Research Institute in Berkeley, Califor
arxiv-2107-12297.creator: Hajer Bahouri, Trevor M. Leslie, Galina Perelman
arxiv-2107-12297.description: Abstract . We study the derivative nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the real line and obtain global-in-time bounds on high order Sobolev norms. 1. Introduction We consider the Cauchy problem for the derivative nonlinear Schrödinger equation (DNLS) on the real line \mathbb{R} : (1) \left\{\begin{array}[]{rcl}i\partial_{t}u+\partial_{x}^{2}u&=&-i\partial_{x}(|u|^{2}u),\\ u\big|_{t=0}&=&u_{0}\in H^{s}(\mathbb{R}),\;s\geq\frac{1}{2}.\end{array}\right.

arxiv-2211-10644.title: A Generalisation of Euler’s Totient Function
arxiv-2211-10644.creator: Vlad Robu
arxiv-2211-10644.description: Abstract . Euler’s totient function, φ ⁡ ( n ) \varphi(n) , which counts how many of 0 , 1 , … , n − 1 0,1,\dots,n-1 are coprime to n n , has an explicit asymptotic lower bound of n / log ⁡ log ​ n n/\log\log n , modulo some constant.

arxiv-2405-16423.title: Energy flux and waveform of gravitational wave generated by coalescing slow-spinning binary system in effective one-body theory
arxiv-2405-16423.creator: Weike Deng, Sheng Long, Jiliang Jing
arxiv-2405-16423.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Weike Deng, Sheng Long, Jiliang Jing. We extend our research on the energy flux and waveform characteristics of gravitational waves generated by merging nonspinning binary black holes through self-consistent effective one-body theory [ 64 ] to include binary systems with slowly spinning black holes. Initially, we decompose the equation for the null tetrad component of the gravitationally perturbed Weyl tensor ψ 4 B \psi^{B}_{4} into radial and angular parts, leveraging the second-order approximation of the rotation parameter a a .

arxiv-2510-25462.title: Action-minimizing periodic orbits of the Lorentz force equation with dominant vector potential
arxiv-2510-25462.creator: Manuel Garzón, Salvador López-Martínez
arxiv-2510-25462.description: Abstract We establish the existence of non-constant periodic solutions to the Lorentz force equation, where no scalar potential is needed to induce the electromagnetic field. Our results extend to cases where a possibly singular scalar potential is present, although the vector potential assumes a leading role. The approach is based on minimizing the action functional associated with the relativistic Lagrangian.

arxiv-2602-07136.title: Radiative Seesaw Model with Baryon Number Violation and Upper Limit on Neutron-anti-Neutron Transition Time
arxiv-2602-07136.creator: Rabindra N. Mohapatra a, Nobuchika Okada b
arxiv-2602-07136.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Rabindra N. Mohapatra a, Nobuchika Okada b. The minimal scotogenic model where small neutrino masses arise via radiative seesaw, is known to provide a unified framework for neutrino mass and origin of matter via leptogenesis.

britannica-1911-elemi.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-elemi.description: Article 'Elemi' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 9), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Islands, probably from Canarium commune (nat. Burseraceae), which when fresh and of good quality is a pale yellow granular substance, of honey-like consistency, but which gradually hardens with age. It is soluble in alcohol and ether, and has a spicy taste with a smell like fennel.

pmc-10536597.title: The Suspended Sediment Flux in Winter in the South of Chengshantou, between the North and South Yellow Sea
pmc-10536597.creator: Bowen Li, Xuejun Xiong, Baichuan Duan, Daolong Wang, Long Yu
pmc-10536597.description: Due to the regional differences between the North and South Yellow Sea, and under the influence of winter winds, the relative changes in the coastal current and the Yellow Sea warm current will lead to the instability of the front, which will lead to the cross-front transport of sediment.

pmc-10542675.title: An online, public health framework supporting behaviour change to reduce dementia risk: interim results from the ISLAND study linking ageing and neurodegenerative disease
pmc-10542675.creator: Larissa Bartlett, Aidan Bindoff, Kathleen Doherty, Sarang Kim, Claire Eccleston, Alex Kitsos, Eddy Roccati, Jane Alty, Anna E. King, James C. Vickers
pmc-10542675.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundUnmanaged cardiometabolic health, low physical and cognitive activity, poor diet, obesity, smoking and excessive alcohol consumption are modifiable health risk factors for dementia and public health approaches to dementia prevention have been called for.

pmc-10649165.title: Evidence-Based Surgery: What Can Intra-Operative Images Contribute?
pmc-10649165.creator: Pietro Regazzoni, Jesse B Jupiter, Wen-Chih Liu, Alberto A Fernández dell’Oca, Andreas Neff
pmc-10649165.description: Evidence-based medicine integrates results from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and meta-analyses, combining the best external evidence with individual clinical expertise and patients’ preferences. However, RCTs of surgery differ from those of medicine in that surgical performance is often assumed to be consistent. Yet, evaluating whether each surgery is performed to the same standard is quite challenging.

pmc-10795831.title: Intestinal transit-amplifying cells require METTL3 for growth factor signaling and cell survival
pmc-10795831.creator: Charles H Danan, Kaitlyn E Naughton, Katharina E Hayer, Sangeevan Vellappan, Emily A McMillan, Yusen Zhou, Rina Matsuda, Shaneice K Nettleford, Kay Katada, Louis R Parham, Xianghui Ma, Afrah Chowdhury, Benjamin J Wilkins, Premal Shah, Matthew D Weitzman, Kathryn E Hamilton
pmc-10795831.description: Intestinal epithelial transit-amplifying cells are essential stem progenitors required for intestinal homeostasis, but their rapid proliferation renders them vulnerable to DNA damage from radiation and chemotherapy. Despite these cells’ critical roles in intestinal homeostasis and disease, few studies have described genes that are essential to transit-amplifying cell function.

pmc-10880829.title: Measuring the Economic Burden of Health Conditions among White-Collar Employees: A Cross-Sectional Study from Delhi-NCR
pmc-10880829.creator: Monika Yadav, B Viji
pmc-10880829.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background:In the past few decades, there has been a significant increase in healthcare expenditure due to the prevalence of health issues across the globe. This is primarily seen among white-collar employees due to the sedentary nature of their jobs, which affects their current earnings (Purchasing Power) directly due to the reallocation of their real income towards healthcare expenditure (Economic Burden) and indirectly by impacting work productivity through sick leaves.Aim:To measure the economic burden of disease(s) among white-collar employees, and to study the

pmc-12431544.title: Repairable, Degradable and Recyclable Carbon Fiber-Reinforced Bio-Based Epoxy Vitrimer Composites Enabled by Facile Transesterification
pmc-12431544.creator: Haidan Lin, Kai Dong, Jingyao Luan, Chenggang Li, Di Zhao, Chengji Zhao, Xuefeng Li
pmc-12431544.description: Developing high-performance bio-based epoxy resins as sustainable alternatives to petroleum-derived bisphenol A (BPA) epoxies for recyclable carbon fiber-reinforced polymers (CFRPs) is pivotal in materials research. Herein, the bio-based bisphenol monomer BDEF was synthesized from the lignin derivative 4-propylguaiacol. The derived epoxy monomer BDEF-EP was cured with adipic acid to form a bio-based vitrimer.

pmc-12613010.title: Observation of type-II and type-III Dirac points in circuit lattices
pmc-12613010.creator: Wencai Wang, Yubin Ma, Muhammad Imran, Bo Lv, Xueqing He, Yongtao Jia, Huibin Tao, Ying Liu, Rujiang Li
pmc-12613010.description: SummaryDirac fermions are low-energy quasi-particle excitations found in Dirac materials, with their band crossings referred to as Dirac points (DPs). Unlike type-I DPs, type-II, and type-III DPs have attracted significant attention due to their unique magneto-transport properties in condensed matter materials.

pmc-12786965.title: Harnessing Both Phase Change and Isomerization: High-Energy-Density Azobenzene-Composites for Efficient Solar Energy Storage
pmc-12786965.creator: Yan Jiang, Jiawei Chen, Yupeng Guo, Rui Liu, Hai Wang, Jin Huang, Wen Luo
pmc-12786965.description: Organic phase change materials (OPCMs) show immense application potential in solar energy storages owing to high energy storage capacity and latent heat efficiency. However, it is difficult to achieve prolonged energy storage due to the sensitivity of phase change to environmental temperature, and adding other substances will lead to a decrease in total energy density.

pmc-13114381.title: Anti-Tumor Immunity in Solid-Organ Transplant Recipients
pmc-13114381.creator: Jeffrey Sum Lung Wong, Karen Hoi Lam Li, Bryan Li, Roland Leung, Desmond Yap, Albert Chan, Tan-To Cheung, Thomas Yau
pmc-13114381.description: Simple SummaryPatients who have received an organ transplant are more likely to have cancer and experience worse outcomes if they do. This is because the ability of the immune system to fight cancer, or anti-tumor immunity, is weakened by the process of transplantation, the transplanted organ itself and the medications required to prevent transplant rejection.

pmc-13390318.title: A deep learning algorithm for coronary heart disease prediction based on retinal fundus photographs and optical coherence tomography
pmc-13390318.creator: Ran Yan, Xiaoxiao Guo, Jiang Zhu, Yan Zhu, Tingting Hong, Weijie Zhang, Zongqing Ma, Xinxiao Gao
pmc-13390318.description: BackgroundCoronary heart disease (CHD) is a major cause of mortality worldwide. This study aimed to develop and validate a multimodal deep learning algorithm using retinal imaging to assist in CHD risk assessment.MethodsIn this retrospective study, we developed a deep learning algorithm that integrates retinal fundus photographs and optical coherence tomography (OCT) images.

pmc-13414135.title: Development and clinical validation of an artificial intelligence based model for thyroid nodule malignancy risk assessment using C-TIRADS guidelines
pmc-13414135.creator: Rongzhou Ye, Yao Liu, Xiuming Wu, Kangjian Wang
pmc-13414135.description: BackgroundThyroid nodules refer to discrete lesions within the thyroid gland, caused by abnormal proliferation of thyroid cells and local growth. Thyroid ultrasound imaging is a non-invasive, widely used technique primarily employed to assess the benign or malignant nature of nodules, the extent of invasion into adjacent tissues, and lymph node metastasis.

pmc-13559193.title: The settings approach to health promotion in schools: examining the role of school policies in fostering student health literacy
pmc-13559193.creator: Didier Jourdan, Ting-Ya Kuo, Min-Chien Tsai, Fu-Li Chen
pmc-13559193.description: This study explores the settings approach to health promotion, which seeks to create supportive environments by addressing multiple health determinants within specific contexts. In schools, this involves not only policy and management but also the organization of the environment, pedagogy, engagement with families and communities, and the provision of health and social services.

pmc-13627687.title: Integrating ultrasound-CT-MR for preoperative multi-task prediction in ovarian cancer: achieving diagnostic parity with multidisciplinary team consensus
pmc-13627687.creator: Jingjing Yu, Peijun Hu, Ruixia Dai, Xiaomin Liu, Shanshan Zhang, Yangdi Xu, Yiwei Gao, Bingjian Lu, Wenqian Wang, Yizhen Niu, Xiaochen Wang, Shihao Xu, Weibin Wang, Qianqian Qi, Fan Liu, Yang Zhang, Sihui Hu, Yu Tian, Weiguo Lu, Jingsong Li, Jiale Qin

pmc-13685342.title: Gold-standard-guided direct preference optimisation for ICD-10-AM and ACHI code assignment from discharge summaries
pmc-13685342.creator: Rajvir Kaur, Jeewani Anupama Ginige, Oliver Obst
pmc-13685342.description: Clinical codes assigned from discharge summaries support clinical research, reimbursement, health resource allocation, and service planning. In Australia, ICD-10-AM and ACHI are used to code diagnoses and interventions for admitted episodes of care, but manual coding is time-consuming, labour-intensive, and subject to variability. This study investigates large language models for automated ICD-10-AM and ACHI code assignment from discharge summaries.
